info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Management API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Management API facilitates the creation and management of fiduciary agreements within banking services. It allows financial institutions to establish and document fiduciary relationships, enabling better compliance and oversight in deposit and lending activities. This API is primarily used by banking personnel who handle fiduciary responsibilities, ensuring that agreements are accurately recorded and accessible. Key operations include initiating new agreements and managing existing ones, streamlining workflows in fiduciary contexts.

post.summary: Create a fiduciary agreement for deposit lending.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new fiduciary agreement within the deposit lending framework. The agreement defines the terms under which the fiduciary will manage the funds on behalf of the parties involved, ensuring compliance with regulations and mutual understanding.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a fiduciary agreement for deposit lending. It requires specific details about the parties involved, the terms of the agreement, and any relevant conditions to ensure proper processing and compliance with applicable regulations.
